Coral photosynthetic yield under diuron and three climate scenarios

Source: R/data.R
coral_pam.Rd

Effective quantum yield of photosystem II in the reef-building coral Acropora millepora exposed to the herbicide diuron, crossed with three climate scenarios, from the same 14-day experiment as coral_colour.

Format

An object of class data.frame with 414 rows and 5 columns.

Details

The design is three climate scenarios by six diuron concentrations by three chambers: 54 chambers. Yield was read repeatedly on the fragments in each chamber, so the chambers hold five to eight readings each and the rows are not balanced. As with coral_colour a chamber sits at one concentration and admits only a displacement, and 54 chambers of several readings is the better conditioned of the two for a ogl(chamber) term.

Chamber was numbered 1 to 3 within each climate-by-concentration cell in the source records rather than across the experiment, so chamber here combines the three to give a unique identifier.

Yield is a proportion and 63 of the 414 readings are exactly 0, all of them at the higher concentrations where photosynthesis had stopped. These are measurements at a boundary rather than substitutions, and a Beta likelihood cannot represent them; vignette("example6") covers the options.

The control concentration is reported as 0, and the substitution the source file holds for it is not shipped, for the reason given under coral_colour.

The columns are as follows:

climate

Climate scenario (fct), "2018", "2050" or "2100".

diuron

Diuron concentration in \(\mu\)g/L (dbl), one of 0, 0.29, 0.96, 2.9, 9.6 and 29.

chamber

Exposure chamber (fct), 54 levels, each at one climate scenario and one concentration.

fragment

Coral fragment within chamber (int).

yield

Effective quantum yield of photosystem II (dbl), a proportion. 63 readings are exactly 0.

References

Flores F, Marques JA, Uthicke S, Fisher R, Patel F, Kaserzon S, Negri AP (2021) Combined effects of climate change and the herbicide diuron on the coral Acropora millepora. Marine Pollution Bulletin, 169: 112582. doi: 10.1016/j.marpolbul.2021.112582.

Examples

head(coral_pam)
#>   climate diuron  chamber fragment yield
#> 1    2018      0 2018-0-1        1 0.686
#> 2    2018      0 2018-0-1        1 0.691
#> 3    2018      0 2018-0-1        2 0.672
#> 4    2018      0 2018-0-1        2 0.664
#> 5    2018      0 2018-0-1        3 0.662
#> 6    2018      0 2018-0-1        3 0.650
with(coral_pam, table(climate, diuron))
#>        diuron
#> climate  0 0.29 0.96 2.9 9.6 29
#>    2018 24   24   24  24  24 18
#>    2050 24   24   24  24  24 17
#>    2100 24   24   24  24  24 19
